name: tag_rooms
description: Tag every placed room visible in the active view (open a floor plan first). Skips rooms that already have a tag in the view and unplaced/unenclosed rooms. Uses the project's default room tag type unless tag_type_id names one. Returns created tag ids with room name/number and tag location in mm. Simplified port of mcp-servers-for-revit tag_all_rooms: the original's automatic view switching was dropped - the caller picks the view.

params.name: use_leader
params.description: Show a leader line on each created tag.

params.name: tag_type_id
params.description: ElementId of a specific room tag type to apply to the new tags. Omit (or 0) to use the project default.
